response.sql: WITH per_examination AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - overall_mean AS deviation FROM per_examination), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess_deviation FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess_deviation IS NULL, excess_deviation DESC LIMIT 10
